name: Samsung Wallet – digital receipts
author: S-ERP
description: Adds an "Add to Samsung Wallet" button to the digital receipt. Samsung requires partner onboarding: register at the Samsung Wallet Partner Portal, create a Generic card template and get its Card ID and Certificate ID. Samsung's 'Data Fetch Link' then asks your public server for the card data, so the receipt link must be publicly reachable (Settings → POS → Public address). Paste the exact link format Samsung gives you; {card_id}, {certificate_id} and {ref} (receipt reference) are filled in automatically.
